tracking_note: Entries describe selected implementations, not Git merge ancestry or deployment. Publication is determined by fork history and AFM's recorded submodule pin. Future fork commits should carry Backport-ID and Upstream-Commit trailers; resolve the corresponding fork commit from those trailers rather than storing a self-referential commit hash here.

backports.scope: Defensive play-style modifiers in both engines and seeded regression tests.
adaptations: Adjusted patch context for AFM's older role-modifier helper; retained upstream behaviour.

backports.scope: Live-engine empty midfield slots and short-handed defensive cover, with seeded scoring/duel regressions.
adaptations: Kept new line-strength helpers crate-private; used AFM-compatible player snapshots and local helper tests.

backports.scope: Second-yellow dismissals count as both a yellow and a red in team/player reports.
adaptations: Adapted rating compatibility to AFM's existing contribution-based rating implementation; preserved its prior second-yellow penalty without charging the dismissal twice.
not_imported: Upstream rating.rs implementation and its separate rating formula.

backports.scope: Formation changes preserve players' lines, rebalance through adjacent lines and retain lineup order.
adaptations: Imported together with ofm-pr-1124's availability-aware rebalancing.

backports.scope: Only players still on the pitch count or move when a formation is rebalanced.
adaptations: Combined with ofm-pr-1016 while retaining AFM's existing substitution/report integration.

backports.scope: Checkpoint coaching, borrowed match observations, tactical dial commands, goalkeeper replacement, complete match periods and the live path for unwatched active club fixtures.
adaptations: Observation module and AI decision integration tests copied verbatim from the source commit.
AI manager implementation reused with a comment adjusted to avoid claiming the deferred between-match blueprint system exists in AFM.
Reused native creation/session APIs in the day loop while retaining AFM's controlled-club rules, host-owned matchday hooks and transaction boundary.
Adapted upstream's scoreline-only recovery to the existing native APIs; retained AFM's separate host forfeit handling.
Added native regression coverage using AFM-compatible game fixtures.
not_imported: Squad-floor, catch-up, dormant-tier and desktop matchday changes outside this integration.

afm_only_changes.scope: Compute each appearance from entry to exit, including a substitute later substituted off or dismissed.
afm_only_changes.reason: The wider use of substitutions exposed inherited overcounting; this fix was added locally and is not attributed to an adopted upstream commit.

baseline_integration.note: This baseline includes the complete upstream history and supersedes the selective implementations below. Their scope, adaptations and not_imported fields describe the historical backports. Git MERGE_HEAD/ancestry, the parent pin, and release records establish pending merge, adoption, and deployment separately.
